column1: # ESP32-P4 partition table for the bike-minimap firmware.
# The factory app partition is sized to 16 MB so the embedded ~9.6 MB
# map-runtime `embedded-city-map-small` feature) fits alongside code and
# read-only data with room to grow. The Waveshare ESP32-P4-Module-DEV-KIT
# ships with 32 MB of SPI flash; the remaining ~16 MB beyond `factory`
# is intentionally left unused for now — we can carve out SPIFFS
# or OTA slots in later steps without disturbing this table.
